chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ibn Fazzal, from one of his companions, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said to Musa: 'Increase your remembrance of Me by night and by day, and be humble during My remembrance, and be patient during My afflictions, and find peace during My remembrance, and worship Me and do not associate anything with Me. To Me is the final return. O Musa! Make Me your treasure and place your store of lasting righteous deeds with Me.'
ai.seo_question: What are the key instructions Allah gave to Musa regarding remembrance and worship?
ai.summary: This Qudsi hadith from al-Kafi underscores the spiritual discipline of constant dhikr and khushu', linking inner tranquility with exclusive worship (tawhid). It introduces the concept of 'al-baqiyat al-salihat' (lasting righteous deeds) as a divine treasure, reflecting the Shia emphasis on accumulating enduring merit for the afterlife through consistent devotion and patience during trials.
